## Description

Models fragmented cryptocurrency or global equity venues as a directed spatial graph, solving the minimum-cost network flow problem to capture multi-hop cross-venue price discrepancies.

## Where it may fit

High market volatility, cross-exchange liquidity fragmentation, network latency variations across venues.

## Vehicles

Cryptocurrency proprietary trading firms, HFT market makers, multi-venue arbitrage funds.

## Required data

Sub-millisecond WebSocket order book feeds across multiple exchanges, transfer fee schedules.

## Caveats

Highly sensitive to network latency, withdrawal freezes, and exchange API rate limits.
